target: Warung counter, pasar stall, pos polisi desk, Pak RT table, lanterns and signs, within the per-hub instance budget, behind an off-by-default LookDev opt-in
candidateRule: all props CANDIDATES awaiting designer yes/no; not approved, not shipped on by default
approach: Pure-data, source-controlled Roblox primitive-part recipes rather than imported meshes: subagent transport was down and place saves are forbidden. Durable in Rojo, reversible, no asset IDs, no place save.

implementation.recipeSource: src/shared/HubPropCandidates.luau (pure data: palette + 4 hub recipes + shared lantern/sign dressing + partsFor(hubKey), no asset IDs)
implementation.lookDevCandidate: hubprops (7th candidate, pure data only, idsSource pointer, hubCount=4, no numeric IDs)
implementation.default: off - shipping greybox hub props untouched
implementation.budget: MAP_SPEC 8-12 props per hub; every hub has 10-11 detail+sign parts (<= 12)
implementation.attachment: details parented to each hub's anchor BasePart (Counter@Pasar, Table@Warung, Desk@PosPolisi, Table@RumahPakRT); hub models found recursively under workspace.World
implementation.palette: ART.md §3 tokens; sign board uses each hub's own accent

studioRoundTrip.method: Play Solo, fresh Client VM; require Shared.LookDev + Shared.HubPropCandidates + the LookDevHubProps adapter from LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts, then LookDev.enable('hubprops')/disable()
studioRoundTrip.note: Restricted Studio MCP execute_luau VM has no Enum.PartType / Enum.Material members; shapeOf/materialOf resolve under pcall with safe defaults. Real LocalScript VM resolves the full enum.

render.note: Front-elevation schematic generated by dumping partsFor() from HubPropCandidates.luau via Lune and drawing all 4 hubs from that SAME data, so render cannot drift from shipped props. A review aid, NOT a Studio screenshot. No agent visually graded the art.
